hero-pairs-a-01-001.text: Isibhakabhaka sicwebile namuhla ekuseni. Noma ubani oshayela ebheke empumalanga ushayela ngekhanda.
hero-pairs-a-01-001.en: Clear sky this morning. Anyone driving east is doing it from memory.

hero-pairs-a-01-002.text: Alikho ngisho ifu elilodwa usuku lonke. Isihlahla esisodwa endaweni yokupaka manje yindawo efunwa yiwo wonke umuntu.
hero-pairs-a-01-002.en: Not a cloud all day. The only tree in the car park is now prime property.

hero-pairs-a-01-003.en: Mostly sunny. Except over your garden.

hero-pairs-a-01-004.text: Kusukela ngesikhathi sebhulakufesi izulu libukeka sengathi lizokuna. Lisabukeka nje.
hero-pairs-a-01-004.en: It's looked like rain since breakfast. Still just looking.

hero-pairs-a-01-005.text: Ilanga alizanga kuma-sundowner. Bonke abanye bafikile.
hero-pairs-a-01-005.en: The sun didn't show for sundowners. Everyone else did.

hero-pairs-a-01-006.text: Umoya omncane uletha intuthu ye-braai yomakhelwane. Uthola konke ngaphandle kwenyama.
hero-pairs-a-01-006.en: Steady breeze from next door's braai. You get everything but the meat.

hero-pairs-a-01-007.text: Kunomoya ofanele kulobu busuku. Omiyane abakwazi ukwehla.
hero-pairs-a-01-007.en: A proper breeze tonight. The mosquitoes have been grounded.

hero-pairs-a-01-008.text: Imvula enhle. UMkhulu usevele ushayela wonke umuntu: 'Nithole engakanani?'
hero-pairs-a-01-008.en: Good rain. Oupa's already phoning round: 'How much did you get?'

hero-pairs-a-01-009.text: Lina ubusuku bonke. I-sprinkler ayikakuqapheli lokho.
hero-pairs-a-01-009.en: Raining all night. The sprinkler hasn't noticed.

hero-pairs-a-01-010.text: Ilanga liphuma lingena usuku lonke, bese kuba yilokhu. Sonke siyamazi umuntu onjalo.
hero-pairs-a-01-010.en: In and out of the sun all day, then this. We all know someone like that.

hero-pairs-a-01-011.text: Isibhakabhaka sicacile ngale ntsasa. Nabani na oqhuba esinga empuma uqhuba ngentloko.
hero-pairs-a-01-011.en: Clear sky this morning. Anyone driving east is doing it from memory.

hero-pairs-a-01-012.text: Akukho nelinye ilifu imini yonke. Ekuphela komthi kwindawo yokupaka ngoku yindawo efunwa ngumntu wonke.
hero-pairs-a-01-012.en: Not a cloud all day. The only tree in the car park is now prime property.

hero-pairs-a-01-013.text: Kunelanga ubukhulu becala. Ngaphandle kwasegadini yakho.
hero-pairs-a-01-013.en: Mostly sunny. Except over your garden.

hero-pairs-a-01-014.text: Ukususela kwisidlo sakusasa kukhangeleka ngathi iza kuna imvula. Kusakhangeleka nje.
hero-pairs-a-01-014.en: It's looked like rain since breakfast. Still just looking.

hero-pairs-a-01-015.text: Ilanga alizanga kwii-sundowners. Bonke abanye bafikile.
hero-pairs-a-01-015.en: The sun didn't show for sundowners. Everyone else did.

hero-pairs-a-01-016.text: Umoya omncinci uzisa umsi webraai yabamelwane. Ufumana yonke into ngaphandle kwenyama.
hero-pairs-a-01-016.en: Steady breeze from next door's braai. You get everything but the meat.

hero-pairs-a-01-017.text: Kukho umoya owaneleyo ngobu busuku. Iingcongconi azikwazi ukuhla.
hero-pairs-a-01-017.en: A proper breeze tonight. The mosquitoes have been grounded.

hero-pairs-a-01-018.text: Imvula entle. UTatomkhulu sele etsalela wonke umntu: 'Nifumene engakanani?'
hero-pairs-a-01-018.en: Good rain. Oupa's already phoning round: 'How much did you get?'

hero-pairs-a-01-019.en: Raining all night. The sprinkler hasn't noticed.

hero-pairs-a-01-020.text: Ilanga liphuma lingena imini yonke, kwaye ngoku le nto. Sonke siyamazi umntu onjalo.
hero-pairs-a-01-020.en: In and out of the sun all day, then this. We all know someone like that.
